_doc: Example chain wax ledger. Copy to chain-wax.json (git-ignored) and edit, or let scripts/chain-wax.py create and update it. One entry per bike. odometer_km is the bike's lifetime distance (Strava gear distance, indoor rides included: a chain wears on the trainer too) at the moment of the wax. next_due_km is [min, max] km after that wax and is fixed when the wax is logged. Bikes with a strava_gear_id read their odometer live; bikes without one are manual (set with `chain-wax.py set-odometer`).
